name: Ace of Wands
title: Ace of Wands
imagery: A great flaming club bursts upward, with ten tongues of fire leaping from it like lightning. It is the raw power of Fire at its source.
meaning: The Ace of Wands is the root of Fire: pure will, creative force and spiritual energy. A powerful new beginning is ready to explode into being.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of the element.

ctx.past: A burst of inspiration began this journey.
ctx.present: Raw creative energy is yours now.
ctx.future: A powerful new beginning is coming.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a fresh start.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be untapped power.

name: Two of Wands
title: Two of Wands: Dominion
imagery: Two crossed thunderbolt wands blaze with flames against a red background. Their energy is fierce and focused.
meaning: Dominion is will in its first expression: power, boldness and control. You have the energy to take charge and shape your world.
numerology: Two is the first expression of the element.
affirmation: I take charge of my world.

ctx.present: You have the power to take control.
ctx.future: A chance to lead is coming.

name: Three of Wands
title: Three of Wands: Virtue
imagery: Three wands topped with lotus flowers cross at the center, radiating warm orange light. They stand balanced and upright.
meaning: Virtue is will established with integrity. Your strength comes from staying true to your principles. Confidence and growth follow.

ctx.future: Recognition for your character is coming.

name: Four of Wands
title: Four of Wands: Completion
imagery: Four wands with a ram's head at one end and a dove at the other are arranged in a circle, forming a wheel. The energy is complete and contained.
meaning: Completion is a cycle of effort fulfilled. Things are settled and orderly. Celebrate what you have achieved.
affirmation: I celebrate what I have completed.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of what comes next.

name: Five of Wands
title: Five of Wands: Strife
imagery: A central winged wand is crossed by four others, sparking with flames and tension.
meaning: Strife is energy in conflict. Struggles and competition test your will. Channel the fire constructively.

ctx.spirit: Your guides ask what is worth fighting for.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be inner conflict.

name: Six of Wands
title: Six of Wands: Victory
imagery: Six wands cross in harmony with flames burning at their tips. The pattern is balanced and triumphant.
meaning: Victory is will rewarded. Success and recognition follow your efforts. Enjoy it with grace.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of losing.

name: Seven of Wands
title: Seven of Wands: Valour
imagery: A rough, heavy club crosses over six more refined wands, blazing with determined fire.
meaning: Valour is courage under pressure. You may face great odds, but your bravery will see you through.

ctx.future: A test of courage is coming.

name: Eight of Wands
title: Eight of Wands: Swiftness
imagery: Eight lightning-like wands cross in rays of light beneath a rainbow, conveying rapid motion and energy.
meaning: Swiftness is energy in rapid motion. News, communication and fast progress are coming. Act quickly.

name: Nine of Wands
title: Nine of Wands: Strength
imagery: Eight arrow-like wands surround a central wand marked with sun and moon, radiating steady force.
meaning: Strength is power that endures. You have great resilience. Stand firm and trust your force.

name: Ten of Wands
title: Ten of Wands: Oppression
imagery: Two great thunderbolt wands bar eight others like prison bars, with flames trapped behind.
meaning: Oppression is fire turned against itself. Pressure and burdens weigh heavily. Find a way to release some of the load.

ctx.spirit: Your guides ask you to lighten up.

name: Page of Wands
title: Princess of Wands
imagery: A naked young woman leaps through flames, holding a wand topped with a sun and grasping a tiger by the tail. She is fearless and fiery.
meaning: The Princess of Wands is daring and enthusiastic. She brings fiery new beginnings and passionate independence.
numerology: The Princess is the element made manifest.

ctx.others: A spirited young person is involved.

name: Knight of Wands
title: Prince of Wands
imagery: A fiery young prince rides a chariot pulled by a lion, holding a phoenix wand. Flames surround him.
meaning: The Prince of Wands is driven and charismatic. He charges ahead with ambition and pride.
numerology: The Prince is the element in motion.
affirmation: I pursue my goals with drive.

name: Queen of Wands
title: Queen of Wands
imagery: A crowned queen sits enthroned in flames, holding a wand topped with a pinecone. A leopard rests at her side.
meaning: The Queen of Wands is radiant and commanding. She leads with warmth, confidence and generosity.
numerology: The Queen is the receptive power of the element.

name: King of Wands
title: Knight of Wands
imagery: An armored knight rides a rearing black horse, carrying a flaming torch. Flames surround him.
meaning: The Thoth Knight of Wands is the most active form of Fire: swift, powerful and bold. He charges forward with explosive energy.
numerology: The Knight is the element at its most active.
